content.title: The Recommendation - Wirecutter Newsletter

extractedData.headline: The best patio furniture
extractedData.description:
Turn your patio into a comfortable, good-looking space, and you'll find yourself gravitating toward it for everything from your morning coffee to your midday break to your al fresco dinner.

After 50 hours of research and assembling and using several outdoor dining sets, we have recommendations for the best pieces of patio furniture—whether you want to splurge on a high-end teak dining set or invest in lounge chairs and sofas. And if you'd rather go rogue, our experts have great advice on how to choose the best patio furniture on your own.

Deck out your patio→
extractedData.disclaimer: We independently review everything we recommend. When you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more ›

extractedData.title: Keep mosquitoes away without slathering your skin in repellent
extractedData.content:
Spatial repellents work like diffusers to effectively and odorlessly reduce mosquito bites when you're hosting a backyard barbecue, lounging on the patio, having a picnic in a park, or playing cornhole in the yard—as long as there's no breeze. Here are the six models that performed the best in our years of tests.

By the way, our top pick is on sale→

(Just make sure to use promo code 20WIRECUTTER.)

globalStyles.embedded: span, td, table, div { -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale; } .st-email-body { width: 100% !important; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; margin: 0 auto !important; padding: 0px; background-color: #ffffff; } .fz-28-lh-10 span { font-size: 28px !important; letter-spacing: -0.8px !important; line-height: 30px !important; } .fz-24-lh-24 span { font-size: 24px !important; letter-spacing: -0.9px !important; line-height: 26px !important; } .fz-18-lh-20 span { font-size: 22px !important; line-height: 22px !important; } .fz-12-lh-20 span { font-size: 12px !important; line-height: 20px !important; }
